questions.question: Why did Chen Gong decide to leave his position as magistrate?
options: He wanted to take over the Han throne.
He wished to join Cao Cao in opposing Dong Zhuo.
He needed to buy land in Qiao.
The emperor had ordered him to retire.
questions.explanation: 陈宫认为必须阻止董卓，于是放弃官职随曹操逃亡。

questions.question: Why did Cao Cao believe the men at Lu Boshe's farm were plotting against him?
options: He overheard them talking about catching someone.
He found a letter ordering his arrest.
The farmer refused to offer him food.
He saw Dong Zhuo waiting in the yard.
questions.explanation: 曹操听到工人说要抓住那个家伙，误以为要抓自己。

questions.question: What were the workers actually preparing to do?
options: Guard a secret passage
Steal Cao Cao's horse
Arrest Chen Gong
Butcher a pig for the meal
questions.explanation: 陈宫发现刀具是屠宰用的，两名工人谈的是猪，不是曹操。

questions.question: What did Chen Gong think about Cao Cao after the killings?
options: He was a kind and careful magistrate.
He had saved every innocent worker.
He was cruel and heartless.
He had already restored peace.
questions.explanation: 曹操杀死无辜工人和卢伯奢，陈宫认为他冷酷无情。

questions.question: What did Cao Cao decide after discovering Chen Gong had gone?
options: Give up trying to raise an army.
Be more careful about his words and reputation.
Return to the magistrate and confess.
Join Dong Zhuo's government.
questions.explanation: 曹操意识到别人可能把他看作恶人，决定谨慎言行。

questions.question: How did Cao Cao persuade many warlords to join his cause?
options: He sent them a fake imperial edict calling for help against Dong Zhuo.
He promised them a share of the Queen's treasure.
He sent the Yellow Turbans to recruit them.
He invited them to a festival in Qiao.
questions.explanation: 曹操伪造朝廷诏书，号召诸侯救献帝、讨董卓。

questions.question: What new position had Liu Bei received for his fighting against the Yellow Turbans?
options: Commander of all eighteen armies
Royal adviser in Luoyang
Magistrate of Pingyuan County
Minister of the Imperial Treasury
questions.explanation: 刘备因抗击黄巾军有功，成为平原县令。

questions.question: Who was chosen to lead the eighteen allied armies?
options: Cao Cao
Sun Jian
Lu Bu
Yuan Shao
questions.explanation: 会盟诸侯推举袁绍统领十八路联军。

questions.question: Whom did Dong Zhuo send to confront the allied armies first?
options: Chen Gong
Hua Xiong
Liu Bei
The White Rabbit
questions.explanation: 董卓没有先派吕布，而是派华雄迎敌。

questions.question: What did Guan Yu promise when Cao Cao offered him warm wine?
options: He would return before the wine became cold.
He would leave the battle to Liu Bei.
He would drink first and wait until evening.
He would ask Yuan Shao to retreat.
questions.explanation: 关羽说先把酒放着，等他得胜归来酒还没凉。
